name: Kami Salon
description: An edgy, fashion-led theme for hair salons: an ink-black ground with chalk text and one magenta accent, Syne capitals over Inter text, and scissor cuts as the signature (photographs, cards and light bands cropped on clean diagonals that flip when you point at them); a floating pill header with a magenta Book button; a home page built as a mosaic of cards (the big title, looks, a number card, a client quote, the menu and the stylists); a footer that ends in a giant wordmark sliced by a magenta cut line; with about, the stylists, the price menu, a booking request form, a journal, a newsletter and contact. The salon details and the price menu are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, the giant footer wordmark, big numbers, prices and the open menu
body text, labels, navigation, the price list details, forms and buttons
